actualTrackingIssueTitle: AutoPerf F133 (not pursued): custom union-metadata lookup remains unmeasured
actualTrackingIssueBody:
## Disposition

**Not pursued as a justified optimization; no shipping change, source PR or timing.** Normal MVC metadata retains the PropertyInfo used at this seam, and a forwarding provider decorator still returns DefaultModelMetadata. The helper excludes non-Property and non-Value metadata before its fallback.

**The original card already explicitly says non-default metadata. That custom extension scenario was not exercised or quantitatively refuted.** This rejection closes an unestablished optimization proposal, not measured no-gain, zero reflection, a literal no-op or proof that custom metadata is unreachable.

## Actual boundary and limits

Public AddMvcCore/AddDataAnnotations registration and IObjectModelValidator create the actual traversal, union getters and IValidatableObject calls. Seven fixed profiles under normal/decorated providers and two repetitions, over Original/default and two rebuilt consumers, produce112 observations, not112 distinct tests. Seventeen reflected properties yield one observed Value-name candidate. Exact model-state keys/messages, getter counts and cached metadata references agree.

The fallback-eligibility field is a source predicate over observed real root/property metadata, not instrumented GetProperty calls or a census of every internal visitor object. Other union reflection and synthetic metadata handling remain.

24 selected source/PE/PDB associations and88 runtime assembly records accompany those four runs. Each complete consumer has279 files; the exact-two-input fresh rebuild changes only common harness DLL/PDB versus its corresponding base, preserving277 other files. Original/default are whole different owner/dependency graphs, not a two-file A/B performance isolation.

Three NETSDK1004 preparation failures preceded their actual restores; the initial overbroad selected-source equality assumption and genuine supplemental default ModelMetadata.cs delta remain disclosed. No product fix or missing-test/red-green claim is made. A custom non-default metadata workload, its frequency and any caching gain remain unverified. No HTTP/browser, live metadata delta, trimming/AOT, complete compiler-input or whole-app claim.

No source branch publication, static cache, API, permanent test, source PR or browser launch. Fixed classified report unchanged. The immutable core predates the additive publication receipt and live campaign-index update.
